component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 162 descending frame 92; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2026-06-25, sum of 8 consecutive pairs (2026-06-25_2026-07-07, 2026-07-07_2026-07-19, 2026-07-19_2026-08-12, 2026-08-12_2026-08-24, 2026-08-24_2026-09-05, 2026-09-05_2026-09-17, 2026-09-17_2026-09-29, 2026-09-29_2026-10-11). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at 110.4383E -7.0081N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane was removed from each pair (long-wavelength atmospheric residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt). Troposphere and solid-earth-tide layers were NOT applied; residual atmospheric noise of a few cm per pair is expected.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
